description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Approves a proposed ad campaign. With activate: true it also switches it on (needs ads:spend too), through the normal activation checks, when its daily budget is within the owner's agent activation ceiling. Inside the owner's agent ceiling it is applied at once; above it the result is `approval_requested`: tell the user the owner has an approval request in Ads > Agent activity, and repeat the same call once they approve. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner. Confirm with the user before activating.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/approve.)

activate.description: Also switch it on. Needs ads:spend as well.

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key do not re-run the activation.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_campaign_approve
title: Approve (and activate) a campaign
